title: Frog eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- frog body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#3fa34d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#7ed957'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='14' ry='8' fill='#b6f09c'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='82' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#2f8f3a'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='82' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#2f8f3a'/>
  <!-- front legs/arms -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3fa34d'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#3fa34d'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- eye bumps -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='10' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='10' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- eyes whites -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='7' fill='#f5f5f5'/>
  <!-- pupils -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='4' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='30' r='4' fill='#1b2a4a'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='1.6' fill='#fff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M36 52 Q50 64 64 52' stroke='#2f8f3a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- snack: little fly/bug going into mouth -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#e6a800'/>
  <!-- bug wings -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#cfe8ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-25 45 52)'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#cfe8ff' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(25 55 52)'/>
  <!-- front toes -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='72' r='2.2' fill='#7ed957'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='75' r='2.2' fill='#7ed957'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='72' r='2.2' fill='#7ed957'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='75' r='2.2' fill='#7ed957'/>
</svg>
